purpose: Deterministic non-shipping authoring blueprint that preassigns T12-owned level/slot/fact-slot/effect/hook/milestone/event identities while keeping exact external producer IDs out of shipping topology.

materialization_contract.external_authority_rule: External T07/T08/T10/T11/later-content identifiers belong in the binding index, never directly in progression_levels_v1.json.
materialization_contract.presentation_requirement_rule: visible_progression_required and major_milestone_completed are T12 presentation/architecture requirements only and may never satisfy an authoritative fact slot.
materialization_contract.later_owner_rule: Unimplemented later content may leave its binding unresolved; the T12 fact-slot identity remains stable and the affected level stays locked until an authoritative producer is registered.
materialization_contract.binding_output_rule: The third shipping dataset progression_bindings_v1.json is materialized only from a fully dispositioned 99-slot resolved binding index; this blueprint never invents producer IDs.

progression_effect_template.semantic: Establish the band objective/state and one practical route/state slot.
Unlock one practical resource/interaction/destination/recipe-family slot owned by the proper task.
Require one player-visible world/camp/production/route improvement tied to authoritative completion.
Unlock one practical loop branch/helper/processing/automation slot without control complexity.
Unlock one meaningful capability/system slot; stat-only/counter-only filler is invalid.
Require one player-visible world/camp/production/route improvement tied to authoritative completion.
Unlock one route/interaction/hazard-response/production-destination slot.
Require meaningful integration of earlier band capabilities without T13 difficulty tuning.
Require a visible improvement that truthfully prepares the band milestone.
Require a major visible/system milestone and expose the next-band transition hook.
